title: Digit Sum
prompt:
Input: one integer per line, until the input ends. Integers can be negative and fit in a `long`.

For each one, print the sum of its digits (ignore the minus sign).

Example: `-472` → `13`
tutorNotes: Trains Console.ReadLine() loops until null, long.Parse, % 10 and / 10. Hidden test is long.MinValue: Math.Abs(long.MinValue) throws OverflowException. Good fixes: work with the remainder's absolute value per digit (Math.Abs(n % 10)), or process the string's digit characters. If only the hidden test fails, ask what Math.Abs returns for the most negative long. Also watch for an infinite loop when n is negative and the loop condition is n > 0 (it just skips) vs n != 0.
